description: This file implements DLL export functions for the AdbWinApi, manages loading of the AdbWinUsbApi.dll, and provides mechanisms to initialize and unload the DLL, including handling of external dependencies and function pointers.

classes.name: CAdbWinApiModule
classes.description: Manages the loading and unloading of the AdbWinUsbApi.dll and caches the function pointer for InstantiateWinUsbInterface.

methods.name: AttachToAdbWinUsbApi
methods.description: Loads the AdbWinUsbApi.dll if WINUSB.DLL is present and caches the InstantiateWinUsbInterface function.
